page.layout: One column of text. Above it: an ornamental border, the printed title block, the chapter heading "CAPVT I." and an italic summary line. Below the summary: the body text, with a large woodcut initial Q. No marginal notes, no running head, no footnotes. Catchword "fi-" at the foot right, signature "A" at the foot left.

main_text.head: LEONIS ALLATII DE SYNODO OCTAVA PHOTIANA.
CAPVT I.

head.i: Synodi coacta a Photio pro sui in thronum con-firmatione, atque restitutione recensentur.

main_text.p: QUID vero de Synodo VIII. Photiana sentiendum est? Eam veram ac legitimam Synodum, & quod magis est, Oecumenicam ex Schismaticis, & potissimum recentioribus plerique agnoscunt, eique titulum Oecumenicæ praefi-

page.notes: The large woodcut initial Q is joined to the word "uid", giving "QUID". Its tail is decorative. The page number "I" is printed at the top right. The title block and the chapter heading are set in large capitals. The summary line is italic, with a printed hyphen in "con-firmatione". The catchword "fi-" repeats the start of the next page. The ligature in "Oecumenicæ" is read as æ, which is a reading from the scan and may need checking.
